name: Forms
description: Every form outside people fill in, on your site, in Google Forms or from an ad, each answer sent to the work it belongs to: one queue of answers with a clock on each, the Lemma's read of what it is, who it went to and why, and a reply drafted in the owner's own mailbox. Nothing is sent until a person presses Send.
